reason: Method is intraday mean-reversion on equity index futures using 1-min/30-min charts, market profile, and balance detection; no concrete long-side daily-bar rules for US stocks.

setup.rule: Market balanced when 65/33 MA flat on 30-min chart
setup.quote: when the lines go flat that's essentially a quick and dirty way to see if the market's balanced

setup.rule: 80% reversion to mean; avoid vertical moves from balance
setup.quote: 80% of the time the market's reverting so in your toolkit you should have a reversion to the mean program

entry.rule: Buy weakness / sell strength after vertical move when balanced detected

exits.rule: Exit if vertical move starts from balance (no retracement expected)
exits.quote: there is zero chance of a retracement from that balanced position with the beginning of a vertical move

market_filter.rule: Use market profile / time variable profiles to detect balance vs imbalance

ambiguities.issue: Mentions futures/indexes and crude; no explicit US stock rules
